about.title: About me
about.text: Software developer with experience in backend applications, APIs, and web and mobile automation using Java and Python. Contributed to a multitenant management system built with Spring Boot and MySQL. Completing the University Technical Degree in Software Development at UADE Costa Argentina, with one final exam remaining.
about.extra: My experience includes backend development with Java, Spring, Python and Flask; REST APIs; web and mobile automation; and SQL databases. I also built an e-commerce website with Node.js, JavaScript and Mercado Pago payment integration.
about.values: Across my projects, I have worked both in a team and across the full application: from backend and data to automation and service integration.

project.nameProject: Sistema de gestión para pinturerías | Tesis universitaria
project.description: University final project graded 9/10, developed in a three-person team. Multitenant system built with Spring Boot, Java 17, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, MySQL, Flyway and Maven. Handles sales, inventory, orders, branches, users and permissions, with revenue and best-selling product reports.

project.nameProject: Botánica del Mar | Tienda web y panel administrativo
project.description: Online natural cosmetics store with an administration panel and Node.js backend. REST API, order and pricing management, authentication, metrics and JSON persistence; Mercado Pago Checkout Pro and webhook integration. Payments were validated with personal live purchases. Developed from June to August 2026.

Technical assessment: Redis caching in a Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS service with Fastify, hexagonal architecture, Docker Compose, Zod validation and CQRS structure. Measured response time fell from 18 seconds to approximately 20 ms in the assessment environment. Work completed in December 2024.

Technical assessment: web application for creating and managing notes. Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, MySQL, validation and Maven backend; React, JavaScript, Bootstrap and Axios frontend. Code delivered in July 2025.

Personal project for managing tasks, employees and teams. Python, Flask and MySQL backend and REST API; authentication with Flask-Login and Flask-Bcrypt. HTML, CSS and JavaScript interface. Endpoints checked with Postman. Developed in March 2025.

project.nameProject: Comparador de precios para compras | Farmashaw
project.description: Price automation tool developed during an administrative role at Farmashaw (January–March 2024). Python, Selenium and openpyxl to compare supplier prices and prepare orders from Excel files. Code published on GitHub in November 2024.
School team project from 2021. Contributed to the PHP and MySQL backend of a digital attendance system. Validated through a small-scale model. Code published on GitHub in October 2022.

project.nameProject: Sistema para administrar carreras y corredores
project.description: Academic Java exercise covering object-oriented programming, classes, inheritance and relationships between races and runners. Published on GitHub in March 2025.
Business website developed as a one-month project for a family business, based on a Figma design. Built with React, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap.

jobs.description: Built a business website from a Figma design using React, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap.
Administrative work in inventory and purchasing. During this period, built a Python/Selenium tool to compare prices and prepare orders.

Backend development with Java and Spring, and Python/Flask APIs for basic product management systems. Automated social media and application workflows with Selenium, Appium and UIAutomator2 on Android emulators and physical devices.
